assertion: The tooling resolver reads the packed React descriptor from the installed tarballs, and descriptor bindings match the actual tarball exports and exact binding and token revisions. Source-tree-only success fails. From the packed `muxui` binary installed from those tarballs: `manifest`, `list`, `search`, and `get` discover and retrieve the React tuple's artifacts; human, `--json`, and `--dense` output normalize to the same response as the catalog API, with dense output inside its token budget; an invalid request returns a structured error with a stable code and `nextCommand`; and each capability P2.1 does not enable (G2.4 to G2.6 and consumer validation) is absent or explicitly unavailable in the manifest. This satisfies Architecture "Command surface", "Query envelopes", "Dense output", and "Self-describing manifest".
basis: E-P2.1-02 under the Roadmap P2.1 acceptance table, Decision 0032, and the P2.1 activation packet

No consumer code, prompts, screens, or traces were captured, so SCOPE-TRUST-EVIDENCE-PRIVACY is not applicable to P2.1.

independentReview.required: an independent reviewer of a different model and harness from the authoring agents, bound to the reviewed revision (P2.1 activation packet, "Roles")

limits: The packed muxui binary runs against the tuple the test packs itself with `pnpm pack` from the checkout at the release commit, at the source manifests' versions. It does not run against the rc tarballs this release published; those are checked by the pack audit, the set install and entry imports, and the descriptor audit, and release preparation does not run the muxui binary against them.
nonClaims: P2.1 is not claimed complete, ready, or exited by this record; the exit condition is judged from the Roadmap, not from this root.
No stable release, support, or assistive-technology claim. Install guidance for these packages uses @next.
latest is observed, not claimed or promoted: on the registry it points at each new package's rc and stayed on @muxui/react's earlier rc (Decision 0023).

The trusted publishers of @muxui/schema, @muxui/catalog, and @muxui/tooling are not yet set up and tokenless publishing is unproved for them; the provenance of their token publish proves neither (Decision 0032 item 10, as amended).

@muxui/schema, @muxui/catalog, and @muxui/tooling each also list a 0.0.0-stage placeholder version. It is no part of the release tuple, carries no provenance, and is not claimed; npm most likely created it, which is inferred and not proved.
Recovery is prepared, not exercised. The first portfolio release has no prior tuple; restoring a prior tuple stays owed by P2 exit.
No consumer validation, clean-consumer offline proof, docs, explorer, or MCP evidence (P2.2 and P2.3).

evidence.title: E-P2.1-02 dense output stays inside every locked token budget

parts.note: The test passes, but it holds `get muxui:component:button --platform web.react --detail full` to a pinned regression ceiling of 3072 tokens, not to the 2048 the command registry sets for `get` at full detail; the test and its comment say that this case exceeds the registry budget (the comment gives 2797 tokens). The registry's own budget fixtures, and `get --platform web.react` at brief and compact, are inside their budgets. The Roadmap names the token budget and no other ceiling; Andrew's choice of the ceiling is recorded only in the body of pull request 418, in no decision or Roadmap text. The retained log shows that the test passed, not the measured count.
parts.part: Dense output is inside its token budget.
